newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel Electric to issue $600 million in bonds.
newsitem.headline: Israel Electric to issue $600 million in bonds.

text.p: State-owned Israel Electric Corp said on Sunday it planned to issue bonds worth up to $600 million overseas sometime before the end of this year.

Israel Electric said chairman Gad Yaacobi informed an annual general meeting of the utility over the weekend of the plans and said the company had already begun contacts with U.S. and European investment banks.

"We've just started the contacts and it is too early to say anything about the terms," a spokeswoman for Israel Electric told Reuters, although she said the offering would likely take place in the United States and Europe.
The planned issue will mark the second big overseas debt offering for the utility, which has a near monopoly on electrical generation in Israel.
In January, the company raised $600 million in 10-, 30- and 100-year bonds in the United States and Europe followed shortly thereafter by a $165 million issue to Japanese investors.
